name: what_is_gross_margin_and_arr_by_customer
question: What is gross margin and arr by customer?
sql:
-- SemaBridge AI Generated Governed Semantic Query
-- Target Engine: Databricks AI/BI Genie & Unity Catalog Metric View
-- Question: "What is gross margin and arr by customer?"
-- Dialect: DATABRICKS
SELECT
    Customer,
    SUM(revenue) - SUM(cogs) AS gross_margin,
    SUM(monthly_contract_value) * 12 AS arr
FROM FINANCE_METRICS_VIEW
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 100;
